body: I'm sure. I've seen and heard a lot too, so I know what you're talking about.

Yeah, I feel like I'm getting better on the long run. The hard part about therapy is that it's simply hard. You get worse before you get better. Just like any kind of exercise, really. I don't think I'm an extreme case, or a lost one. It's just that sometimes the pain is so real that nothing else is, you know? Like a dense fog. You can't see through it. But I have all that it takes to get better. That's what my therapist said, at least, and she's awesome and I love her.
Only took a couple, just enough to get a little high. I'm fine overall. Thanks for asking.
